derivation: from an unused root. meaning to walk; walking;
def: Salcah, a place East of the Jordan

occurrences.text: All the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, unto Salchah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
And reigned in mount Hermon, and in Salcah, and in all Bashan, unto the border of the Geshurites and the Maachathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.
And the children of Gad dwelt over against them, in the land of Bashan unto Salchah:
